title: Proverbs 10: The Proverbs of Solomon
body:
Read the chapter → [Proverbs 10](/bible/proverbs/10)

**[Proverbs 10:1-16](/bible/proverbs/10#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/proverbs/10#v1)</sup> The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/proverbs/10#v2)</sup> Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/proverbs/10#v3)</sup> The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/proverbs/10#v4)</sup> He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/proverbs/10#v5)</sup> He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/proverbs/10#v6)</sup> Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/proverbs/10#v7)</sup> The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/proverbs/10#v8)</sup> The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/proverbs/10#v9)</sup> He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/proverbs/10#v10)</sup> He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/proverbs/10#v11)</sup> The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/proverbs/10#v12)</sup> Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/proverbs/10#v13)</sup> In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/proverbs/10#v14)</sup> Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/proverbs/10#v15)</sup> The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/proverbs/10#v16)</sup> The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

**[Proverbs 10:17-32](/bible/proverbs/10#v17)**

> <sup>[17](/bible/proverbs/10#v17)</sup> He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/proverbs/10#v18)</sup> He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/proverbs/10#v19)</sup> In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/proverbs/10#v20)</sup> The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/proverbs/10#v21)</sup> The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/proverbs/10#v22)</sup> The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/proverbs/10#v23)</sup> It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/proverbs/10#v24)</sup> The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/proverbs/10#v25)</sup> As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
>
> <sup>[26](/bible/proverbs/10#v26)</sup> As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/proverbs/10#v27)</sup> The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/proverbs/10#v28)</sup> The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
>
> <sup>[29](/bible/proverbs/10#v29)</sup> The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
>
> <sup>[30](/bible/proverbs/10#v30)</sup> The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
>
> <sup>[31](/bible/proverbs/10#v31)</sup> The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
>
> <sup>[32](/bible/proverbs/10#v32)</sup> The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
